name: Schradernator SMP Survival
description:
Schradernator SMP is a free Minecraft Bedrock server that opened in October 2026.

HOW TO JOIN

Address: play.schradernator.com

Port: 19132

Windows, Android, iPhone, iPad: Play > Servers > Add Server.

Xbox, PlayStation, Switch: consoles can't add servers by address, so the server has its own Xbox account. Play > Friends > Add Friend > search DeveloperType. The server accepts and sends you an invite (this can take a minute); then join "Schradernator SMP" from Joinable Friends.

THE WORLDS

Hub: everyone lands here. Four gates, three timed parkour courses, leaderboards and the rules.

Survival: /claim the chunk you stand on and nobody else can build, break or open chests there. Coins from mining, mobs, playtime and daily rewards. /shop, /pay, /sethome, /warp, /tpa, /rtp, /back. A starter kit, daily kits and a login streak. Every block placed or broken is logged, so griefed builds can be put back. PvP is on in the wild and off inside claims and at spawn.

Skyblock: start on a small island in the sky and grow it, alone or with friends. Islands are ranked.

Creative: claim a 32x32 plot with /plot and build anything. Trust friends to build with you.

Minigames: Bed Wars, SkyWars, Hunger Games, Murder Mystery, Build Battle, Block Party, TNT Tag, Spleef. Wins pay coins.

STORE

Cosmetics only: titles, hub flight, pets, auras, hats, costumes. Nothing that helps you win.

RULES AND HELP

Be kind, no cheating, no griefing or stealing, no spam. Use /report in game. A person answers at mc.schradernator.com/support, on Discord in #support, and on the Schradernator SMP Facebook Page.

Vote here, then type /vote in game: 100 coins per vote.

Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft. Pictures are rendered from the server's own builds.
